The '''Forensics investigation kit''' was a specialized model of [[Tool kit/Legends|tool kit]] produced by [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and used by [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]] for crime scene investigations.<ref name="Far Horizons" />
